people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Whatever man there is of the house of Israel who kills a bull, or lamb, or goat in the camp, or who kills it outside the camp,
translations.bsb: ‘Anyone from the house of Israel who slaughters an ox, a lamb, or a goat in the camp or outside of it
translations.kjv: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it out of the camp,
translations.asv: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it without the camp,
